anthropic-body-under-openai-protocol.jso.why: The body must be in the client's protocol so the harness parses it natively (B4).

budget-denial-without-retry-after.json.why: A 429 budget denial carries retry-after, the integer seconds until the window resets (B4).

budget-detail-on-policy-denial.json.why: Budget figures belong only to budget denials; a policy denial reveals no budget (A4).

ceiling-as-string.json.why: Money is an integer number of nano-dollars, never a string (6.4).

day-window-resetting-midday.json.why: Windows are UTC calendar days or months (7.1), so retry-after counts to midnight (B4).

extra-body-key.json.why: The body is closed; an extra key could carry request content (C2).

message-echoes-request.json.why: Messages are fixed templates; a message built from the request could carry its content (C2).

openai-body-missing-param.json.why: OpenAI's error object always has message, type, param, and code; clients read all four.

openai-body-under-anthropic-protocol.jso.why: Claude Code reads Anthropic's error shape; an OpenAI-shaped body would not parse natively (B4).

openai-budget-denial-as-rate-limit.json.why: Codex stops retrying only on insufficient_quota; any other 429 type makes it sleep and retry (B4).

policy-denial-as-429.json.why: A policy denial is 403 (C3); a 429 would make harnesses retry a request that can never pass.

remaining-not-below-ceiling.json.why: A strict budget denies only when remaining is below the ceiling (7.6 step 2); otherwise the request fits.

retry-after-on-unbounded-denial.json.why: An unbounded request fails the same way on retry, so a 400 never invites one.

retry-after-zero-on-budget-denial.json.why: retry-after rounds up and is at least 1; 0 would make clients retry into the same exhausted window (B4).
